objectives.title: Vera Rubin Ridge — Highfield drill site
objectives.description: Gray outcrop on Vera Rubin Ridge, drilled by Curiosity on sol 2224 (Nov 8, 2018) after the failed attempt at Inverness due to the rock's hardness.
objectives.science_question: Are Vera Rubin Ridge's resistance and its hematite due to diagenetic alteration by groundwater rather than a layer of different composition?
activities: Brushing with the DRT (Dust Removal Tool)

objectives.title: Glen Torridon (clay-bearing unit) — Aberlady and Kilmarie
objectives.description: Clay-bearing unit south of Vera Rubin Ridge; Aberlady was drilled on sol 2370 and Kilmarie, ~80 cm away, on sol 2384. CheMin measured the highest clay abundances of the mission up to that point.
objectives.science_question: How abundant are the clay minerals preserved in the Glen Torridon unit, and what does that say about the persistence of Gale's ancient lake?

objectives.title: Gediz Vallis channel — Mammoth Lakes drilling (elemental sulfur)
objectives.description: Field of light-toned rocks in the Gediz Vallis channel where Curiosity cracked a rock (May 30, 2024) and exposed elemental sulfur crystals; drilling was done on the nearby rock 'Mammoth Lakes' (Jun 18, 2024).
objectives.science_question: How did the elemental sulfur in the Gediz Vallis channel form, under conditions not associated with this site's history?
activities: Mastcam panorama of the rock field

objectives.title: Marias Pass — Buckskin drilling (silica and tridymite)
objectives.description: Murray formation outcrop at Marias Pass with high silica content (~74 wt% SiO2), drilled on sol 1060 (Jul 31, 2015). CheMin identified tridymite, a high-temperature silica mineral never before found on Mars.
objectives.science_question: Does Buckskin's tridymite come from silicic volcanism in the Gale lake basin or from another alteration process?
